modes.label: 18v18 Annihilation
modes.summary: Build a large event roster for an 18-player team.
notes: No special pick/ban draft is documented in the official Season 10.5 notes.
Duplicate heroes are reported as allowed by secondary mode references.
Role balance is guidance only; no official role composition restriction is documented.

modes.label: Avengers: Infinity War
modes.summary: Plan six two-player squads for the Infinity Stone event.
notes: The official notes describe 12 players forming six duo squads.
Each round has two squads competing to collect Infinity Stones.
A formal pick/ban order is not documented; this tool is a planning simulator.
